description: Opens the interactive lesgooo planner (When, Where, Event, Checklist, Splitwise) in the conversation, optionally on a saved plan and module and as a previously selected participant. Without a plan it shows an unsaved local draft. Opening saves nothing. Use when the user wants to see or edit the plan visually.

participant_id.description: Previously selected participant in this plan; requires participant_token.

participant_token.description: Token returned by join_plan/create_plan for this participant and plan; requires participant_id.

name: open_planner
title: lesgooo planner
